Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 12 Marrickville Park and Morton Park

Clause 9.12.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains three Heritage Conservation Areas being the Porter’s Brickworks Estate Heritage Conservation Area, Jarvie Avenue Heritage Conservation Area and the Rathlin Estate Heritage Conservation Area. This precinct also contains a small part of the HCA 28 Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area located on Marrickville Road.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.12.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect significant streetscapes and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.12.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residential character of the precinct.

Clause 9.12.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off-street car parking does not adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.
